title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini for local developer deployment
summary: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4-billion-parameter multimodal model requiring approximately 20 GB of memory. The release features a 1-million-token context window, Apache 2.0 licensing, Hugging Face weights, and hosted Tinker API pricing at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.
research_notes:
Download the model weights from the Hugging Face repository or pull the model in Ollama via ollama run thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini.

Deploy locally on hardware with at least 20 GB to 32 GB of memory, such as an Apple Silicon Mac or 24 GB GPU, using vLLM or Ollama.

Query the model through the Tinker hosted API at 15 cents per million input tokens and 50 cents per million output tokens.

Allocate at least 24 GB to 32 GB of unified memory when running locally to accommodate the ~20 GB model weights alongside KV cache for extended context.

Utilize the 1M token context window for large codebase ingestion and agentic tool-use loops rather than truncated context windows.
